practiceReport.name: Jonathon Brooks
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (RB) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
factors: 21-day IR window open (Week 3); logged Full Participation in prior week's ramp
Requires formal 53-man roster activation prior to weekly NFL transaction deadline
practiceReport.beatComment: Brooks was a full practice participant in all three sessions during Week 11 prep. However, the third-year running back is not quite ready to be activated from injured reserve, and he's slated to miss his eighth consecutive game while recovering from a groin injury. Trevor Etienne, Anthony Tyus and AJ Dillon will continue to operate as the Panthers' backfield depth options behind Chuba Hubbard in the absence of Brooks, whose next opportunity to play is Week 12 against the Buccaneers on Monday, Nov. 30.

practiceReport.name: Mike Jackson
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (77% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
practiceReport.beatComment: Jackson was designated to return from injured reserve Wednesday and has practiced in full since then. He was listed as questionable to suit up versus Baltimore, though he is now cleared to play for the first time since Week 3.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Jaycee Horn
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Horn is currently considered day-to-day, but head coach Dave Canales wants to ensure Horn is in a great head space before returning. The 2021 first-round pick has been sidelined since late September, while Chau Smith-Wade has handled slot-cornerback duties in his absence. The Panthers will still have to officially activate Horn off injured reserve before he's eligible to return.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Isaiah Simmons
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Simmons will be required to miss at least the next four games for Carolina. He's logged just six defensive snaps this season and another 206 on special teams.
